note_gap: No data between 2023-03-01 and 2025-08-18 in the raw files (source gap, not cleaning).

cleaning_rules.R1: Timestamps treated as UTC (checked against sun position, src/check_utc.py), Europe/Madrid local time added
cleaning_rules.R2: Full hourly grid per regime; missing hours are empty rows (not imputed)
cleaning_rules.R3: Dead circuits dropped: SE|Projector (always 0), SW|RACK (stops Dec 2021)
cleaning_rules.R4: NW|Emerg. Lighting sign flipped (meter wired in reverse)
cleaning_rules.R7: Stuck sensor: same non-zero value 6+ h -> missing (Regime A)
cleaning_rules.R8: Dropout: 6+ h of 0 where the circuit is normally > 1 W -> missing
cleaning_rules.R11: Regime B hours built from < 30 one-minute readings -> low_coverage flag
cleaning_rules.R12: Zone and storey totals recomputed from clean circuits (only if all circuits present)
